notes.title: 2nd Anniversary Update Ver. 1.8.192.717
notes.notes:
preface

We have finally celebrated the second anniversary of the game's release!

Here we bring you a large number of updates on the latest content!

Game development has come to an end, and it can be officially released this year!

The next thing to do is to conduct the final major update of the EA phase next month.

The main plot of all 10 chapters and several branches of the female protagonist Ji Yu are updated in one breath!

After these are completed, I will have to close the development for a period of time and complete the English translation work. Once completed, it will be converted to the official version!

The main storyline and other revisions of the remaining third protagonist Marta will be waiting for the official version to meet everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/1ce382ce069cee1eca1d5af1889146a74b33ffba.png
system

The character EX slot has been changed from 3 grids to display specific numerical values.

The maximum is 100 points, and 33 points are approximately equal to the original 1 grid.

All skill EX consumption has been adjusted.

Most skill costs have been reduced, making their usage more flexible.



collect

After implementing all 100 "Monthly Power" character upgrades, you can fully upgrade them.



region

Peach Blossom Spring: Open up a complete area and related tasks.

[Sakura Forest] Add a new area [Netherworld Vault].

Add a new area called Magic Dragon Nest to the Western Mining Area.

Jino Forest - New Area - Forest Edge Open Space.

Chang'an has opened up some scenes for collecting 100 months of power.

The series of tasks in Chang'an have not been implemented yet and will be updated in the next version. Stay tuned!



store

【 Black Shop 】 Lvzi has added a top-level store that can exchange orange weapon blueprints.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/be14967860a28d5ee5581563cc76070ba33b02b7.png

Bounty offered

Remade the Adventure Mode and related weapons and equipment.

Added more random and reward content.

It is now divided into three levels: 20, 30, and 40.

Corresponding to blue, purple, and orange equipment respectively.

Cat coins and materials have become easier to obtain.

Players can obtain powerful equipment more smoothly from adventure mode.

Adjusted the level of BOSS in Bounty 3, from the original level 20 to level 30. Rewards will also be correspondingly increased.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/a2d928e178f225413ad36ccd746ed705b69effce.png

equipment

Added the emblem of the second season of Flower Language, which can be unlocked by finding flower seeds in the advanced difficulty of "Hundred Flower Island" in adventure mode.

Afterwards, you can go to the flower shop in the eastern district of Portral to draw flower language tickets for the second season.

Obtaining an S-level rating for advanced adventure difficulty will also directly reward one second season golden flower language.

PS, the second season's flower language needs to be synthesized through the first season's flower language and cannot be directly drawn.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/6b4fde6fba81e175f3794586d4abf8e3ad6e796c.png
task

The track puzzle for the mine has been remade and switch diagrams have been added.

Several new tasks and equipment rewards have been added, corresponding to different levels, making the player's development process more comfortable. Roughly as follows.

New 【 Comfort the Heroes 】 located at 【 Tomb of the Warriors 】

Newly added 【 Wang Li Investigation Team 】 located on 【 Wang Li Library 3F 】

Newly added "Immortal Guide" located at "Shilipo"

Newly added "Fury of the Mountains" located in "Western Mines"

Newly added "Bamboo Forest Hermit" located at "Shilipo"

Newly added 'Robbed Guanyin Hall' located in 'Peach Blossom Spring'

Newly added "Essential Experience" located in Chang'an

Newly added "Tianjiang Dilu" located in "Hope Town"

Add [Father and Child] located in [Hope Town]




New important roles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/f4d35d27f9e904578a4ddeb26e8c288e620b3a13.png

The Immortal with One Heart is located at the hidden point of Shilipo.

Responsible for conducting investigations related to the magical animal series.

There will be new magical animal missions launched in the future.

The investigation of each magical animal can produce unique and powerful equipment.



Partial character redraws.

Both Huazi and Hongye have been redrawn.

notes.title: 1.5 Main storyline ending update+30%OFF
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/d1e84bf4d1b68d36c1027de520baf1f3cbe78994.png
Plot

Add the main plot of chapters 9 and 10.

Welcome to the grand finale of 'Kozaki Cong Chapter'!



scene

[Mysterious Forest] has been redrawn (prologue scene, related to Chapter 10)

Added Chapter 9 related to Skeleton Island

Added Chapter 10 related to 'Dark Moon Temple' and 'Dream Forest'



frame

Fixed mapping errors after some scenes died.

The cherry blossom forest has added the effect of petals falling.

Added new particle visual effects.

The background images of all combat scenes have been redrawn.

Some characters have been redrawn and optimized. (Further optimization will be carried out in the future)

PS: Some art uses old versions of resources and some temporary resources, resulting in inconsistent styles.

In the official version, I will personally redraw and add character emoticons.



Skill adjustment

Open the upper limit of level 40, add 2 talent skills to all characters, and all 24 new skills.

All characters' old skills have also been adjusted to varying degrees, and their performance has been comprehensively improved.

All characters' combat power has been improved. Please refer to the in-game skill description for details.

PS: No characters have been weakened!

Fixed an error where the SP did not display correctly.

Fixed the impact of the character's own level on skill damage, now increasing skill damage for every level raised.



equipment

Newly added Chamber of Commerce level 4 purple equipment, dozens of weapons and armor.



other

Significantly reduced the difficulty of stealing vegetables. Reduce the number of pumpkin monsters from 12 to 8.

After Chapter 8 is approved, add 3 landing points: Expeditionary Army Restaurant, Hermit Assembly Hall, and Skeleton Island Sentry

The level and materials of the Chamber of Commerce have been readjusted, making it easier to obtain transaction materials and upgrade equipment.



Subsequent plans

At present, the main line of [Kozaki Cong] has been completed.

In addition to fixing bugs. Afterwards, prepare to supplement more interactive content between the branch and the real world.

New bounties and fishing are already being done. These contents will be updated soon.

Once the above is completed, you can create the main story of the female lead 'Ji Yu Chapter'!

Next, we will welcome the arrival of the official version!

The Marta chapter will be retained and updated together with the official version.

I will keep it for the official version of the 'Future Talk' and meet everyone again!

We are sure to make Chapter 11 of the main theme of the 'Tomorrow's Talk'. Stay tuned!

notes.title: The Early Access version of 《Lolita expedition》 is officially on sale today!
notes.notes:
hello everyone! I'm Shu Yi, producer of 《Lolita expedition》.
I am very excited to announce that the PC version of 《Lolita expedition》 is now officially live!
Thank you for all your support before release!
The game is in the Early Access, and there are still many imperfections. I will strive to improve the game experience!
At present, you can play 1-5 Stories (10 stories in total) of the main line of the game. The game duration is about 10-15 hours.
New content is already being done (new folder). I will update the follow-up content as soon as possible!
If you have any questions or suggestions, please leave a message in the comment area. I will take every comment seriously!
